label: QAOA toy on Braket SV1 (exploratory receipt, NOT an advantage claim)
device: Amazon Braket SV1 (on-demand state-vector simulator, us-east-1)
circuit: Bell state: H q[0]; CNOT q[0],q[1]; 2 qubits, 100 shots
no_speedup_statement: No quantum device expedites the QUBO calculations in this engagement today. D-Wave annealers left Braket in 2022; a 108-qubit QPU cannot hold one 289-variable subproblem. This toy is a labeled exploratory receipt that the Braket path works; the production QUBO solver is classical simulated annealing (SIMULATED), which is the measured win.
cost: SV1 at $0.075/min, 100 shots; within the $100 cap
